hook: Karimnagar medical college gets a *March-end* deadline amid protests
hook_b: Karimnagar medical college gets a *March-end* deadline amid protests
tldr: Health Minister Damodar Raja Narasimha set new deadlines for Karimnagar Medical College and its hostels as students protest over lack of basic facilities.

beats.what: The girls' hostel is due by end-November, the boys' hostel by December-end and the college building by March-end.
beats.why: Students of Government Medical College, Karimnagar are protesting a lack of basic facilities.
beats.care: The review also covered Siddipet Teaching Hospital (due last week of March) and Warangal Super Specialty Hospital.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Husnabad Area Hospital will expand from 100 to 250 beds with a new ₹82 crore building.

cards.q: Will these hospital deadlines be met?

qs: How long have Karimnagar students waited for these buildings?
What happens if the deadlines slip again?

facts.t: Husnabad's new *250-bed* building is sanctioned at ₹82 crore.

viz.verdict: More beds for patients in Husnabad

watch: Girls' hostel due by end-November; boys' hostel by December-end.
